intent: 做一条30秒手机实拍感视频，一架现代垂直起降战斗机从公路板车上起飞，最后冲向远处天空。

plan.title: Vertical Take‑Off
plan.logline: A modern VTOL fighter lifts from a road cart and soars into the sky in a dynamic smartphone‑style shoot.

shots.title: Plane on Road Cart
shots.purpose: Show the fighter positioned on a road cart, establishing context.
shots.openingState: The camera is framed at medium height, showing a sleek VTOL fighter resting on a sturdy road cart parked beside an open highway. The sun glints off its metal surface.
shots.event: The pilot steps onto the cart, checks instruments, and gives a brief nod to himself.
shots.endingState: The plane remains stationary as the pilot stands beside it, ready for launch.

shots.title: Engine Start
shots.purpose: Capture the moment engines ignite and the aircraft begins to lift.
shots.openingState: The pilot is in the cockpit, hands on controls. The camera remains at medium shot, focused on the cockpit view through the windshield.
shots.event: The pilot pulls the throttle forward; engine turbines roar to life, emitting a low hum and a plume of blue-white exhaust.
shots.endingState: The aircraft's nose tilts upward slightly as it begins to rise off the cart.

shots.title: Lift Off
shots.purpose: Show the aircraft leaving the ground and ascending.
shots.openingState: The camera follows the plane as it lifts, maintaining a medium shot that captures both the aircraft and the road below.
shots.event: The VTOL fighter rises steadily, wheels retracting; the pilot's visor reflects the passing scenery.
shots.endingState: The aircraft is clear of the cart, hovering slightly before gaining altitude.

shots.title: Soaring into Sky
shots.purpose: Conclude with the aircraft ascending into the horizon.
shots.openingState: The camera pulls back to a wide view, showing the plane gaining altitude against a clear blue sky.
shots.event: The VTOL fighter climbs higher, its silhouette growing smaller as it disappears into the distance.
shots.endingState: Only the faint outline of the aircraft remains against the sky, fading out of frame.
